name: Daniel Bodi Gil
headline: Senior Product Designer & UX Engineer
summary: Product designer and UX engineer with 15+ years across enterprise healthcare, mobility, banking and telecom. Leads system strategy and implements it hands-on, connecting product research to reusable UI, token pipelines, CSS architecture and developer tooling. At Solidaris, sole lead and implementer of the design-system engineering work, from both Figma/repository flows to metadata, CI gates, Storybook and every foundation.
competencies: Design-system architecture and governance | Storybook | Figma | Design tokens and CSS sources of truth | Angular / TypeScript | PrimeNG | ITCSS / BEMIT | Metadata contracts and CI | AI-assisted development | UX research and prototype testing | Information architecture | Accessibility (WCAG AA)

page_one_roles.intro: Sole lead and implementer of the system engineering for Plectrum, alongside product design across iShare, iCRM and an initial iGED interface draft. Built on the existing PrimeNG/Plectrum UI Kit foundation.
bullets: Designed and implemented both token flows: Figma-to-repository imports through staging, drift checks and reviewed promotion; repository-to-Figma proposal and write tooling with designer review.
Established CSS as the source of truth for rendered foundations and application styling. Structured shared SCSS with ITCSS/BEMIT, semantic tokens and contained PrimeNG theme bridges.
Built the metadata source of truth: typed component contracts, a generated discovery index and documentation shared by developers and AI agents. Defined specialist roles and implementation protocols.
Implemented CI gates for token drift, contract/Angular API alignment, documentation consistency and generated-file freshness, plus packed-consumer checks and coordinated package versioning.
Built the live Storybook and every foundation, including token discovery, spacing and typography playgrounds, component states and usage guidance. Defined contribution, ownership and promotion rules.
Led product research, shadowing, workshops and scenario-based prototype testing. Designed case-comprehension and expert-workflow patterns across the healthcare applications.
Preparing the October handoff: consumer guidance stays in Storybook; architecture decisions and operating knowledge transfer to the team's documentation platform.

page_one_roles.intro: Progressed from sole designer to leading design workflows on FleetBridge, a fleet-management platform, and built its design-system foundation.
bullets: Made CSS the source of truth for production UI and live Storybook foundations, with documentation populated from the browser CSSOM.
Architected SCSS across eight ITCSS layers with BEM naming and a browser-derived colour system built from 15 base hues for two themes.
Delivered reusable components and guidelines; the development team reported approximately 60% faster feature work after adoption (informal team estimate).
Grew the design function from one to three designers, reviewed pull requests and coached developers on CSS architecture, component use and UI quality. Secured investment in the design system.

page_two_roles.intro: Led end-to-end design of the QC1 interface for a radiopharmaceutical quality-control device in a safety-critical operational domain.
bullets: Designed realistic device visualisations for valves, columns, injectors, pipelines and schedules, matching technicians' physical mental model.
Designed for visual impairment from the start: status used pattern, text and hierarchy as well as colour.
Task-based testing reported 85% task success and approximately three-times faster prototyping after the component approach (team-reported estimates; formal baselines were not retained).
Established Nx/Angular, ITCSS/BEM and Storybook foundations, then coached the internal developer who took over the front-end system.

page_two_roles.intro: Modernised front-end foundations and design workflows for enterprise banking software.
bullets: Introduced BEM and replaced Bootstrap 3's float-based layout with a custom Flexbox grid, reducing UI technical debt.
Initiated a design-system direction combining documentation, reusable components and hands-on coaching for a junior front-end team.

page_two_roles.intro: Delivered responsive, cross-browser product UI for high-traffic telecom sites and applications in Adobe Experience Manager.
bullets: Built reusable interface components and introduced BEM to improve CSS structure across Base and Telenet work.
Added npm tooling and automatic reload workflows that removed manual compile cycles from front-end changes.

education: BAC Design & Web Development - Format 21, La Louviere | 2009 - 2010
